title: Digital Product Manager
description:
Location NANAKRAMGUDA, HYDERABAD, India Category Information Technology Job Id R000158487 Job Type Full time Experienced Professionals
  
**Job Location**


HYDERABAD OFFICE INDIA PSC PGH**Job Description**


P\&G was founded over 180 years ago as a simple soap and candle company. Today, we're the world’s largest consumer goods company and home to iconic, trusted brands that make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways. We've spanned three centuries thanks to three simple ideas: leadership, innovation and citizenship. The insight, innovation and passion of hardworking teams have helped us grow into a global company that is governed responsibly and ethically, that is open and visible, and that supports good causes and protects the environment. This is a place where you can be proud to work and do something that matters.

**Dedication from Us:** You'll be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility, in creative workspaces where new insights thrive. All the while, you'll receive outstanding training to help you become a leader in your field. It is not just about what you'll do, but how you'll feel: encouraged, valued, purposeful, challenged, heard, and inspired.

**What we Offer:** Continuous mentorship – you will collaborate with peers and receive both formal training as well as day\-to\-day mentoring from your manager dynamic and encouraging work environment– employees are at the centre, we value every individual and support initiative, promoting agility and work/life balance.

**The Opportunity**


We are looking for a Digital Product Manager to join our Digital Products team and build digital products and capabilities that solve meaningful business problems. This role is designed for a professional with prior technology experience who can connect business needs with technology solutions and translate strategy into products that deliver measurable outcomes.


You will work at the intersection of business, technology, data, users, and AI. You will understand user and business needs, shape product strategy, prioritize opportunities, work closely with engineering and technology teams, and drive products from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Position Responsibilities**

**Own Product Vision, Strategy \& Roadmap**

* Define product vision, objectives, roadmap, priorities, and success measures aligned to business outcomes.
* Understand user needs, business processes, pain points, and opportunities and translate them into clear product requirements and user stories.
* Own backlog prioritization, balancing business value, user experience, technical feasibility, risk, dependencies, and engineering capacity.
* Use data, user feedback, experimentation, and business signals to make informed product decisions.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and create scalable digital capabilities
* Build 0\-1 Products which are AI Native first.

**Drive Product Delivery**

* Lead cross\-functional product initiatives from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with engineering, data, architecture, design, security, and technology teams to translate product intent into scalable solutions.
* Understand technical constraints, architecture choices, APIs, data dependencies, and delivery trade\-offs sufficiently to make effective product decisions.
* Create clarity on requirements, priorities, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
* Track delivery progress, proactively address risks and blockers, and ensure commitments remain aligned to product priorities.

**Influence Stakeholders \& Drive Change**

* Build alignment among stakeholders with different priorities, perspectives, and levels of technical understanding.
* Influence without relying solely on formal authority and create commitment around priorities, decisions, and trade\-offs.
* Drive change management through stakeholder engagement, communication, training, adoption, and feedback loops.
* Anticipate resistance and create practical approaches to move users and stakeholders toward adoption.
* Act as a trusted partner and 'go\-to' person for the products and initiatives you own.

**Build Data\- and AI\-Enabled Products**

* Identify opportunities where data, analytics, AI, GenAI, automation, or digital technologies can improve business outcomes.
* Work with data and technology teams to ensure products are built on trusted, accessible, and appropriately governed information.
* Explore AI\-enabled experiences and workflows that help people access information, make better decisions, and reduce repetitive work.
* Ensure AI and automation capabilities are introduced with appropriate human oversight, controls, and accountability.

**Drive Adoption \& Value Realization**

* Define product KPIs, adoption metrics, user experience measures, and value metrics.
* Use product usage and business performance signals to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop stakeholder engagement and adoption plans for new capabilities.
* Create feedback mechanisms that continuously bring user and business insights back into product development.
* Ensure products deliver measurable value beyond initial launch.

**Partner with Technology \& External Teams**

* Collaborate with engineering, architecture, data, design, cybersecurity, IT, and vendor teams.
* Manage technology and business dependencies required to deliver product outcomes.
* Partner with vendors and external technology providers where required, ensuring clarity of outcomes, delivery expectations, and accountability.
* Contribute to solution design, testing, release planning, reliability, security, data quality, and long\-term sustainability.

 **The Ideal Candidate**

* Has an MBA or prior hands\-on experience in technology, software, data, IT, digital engineering, or a related technical environment building AI native products.
* Has less than 3 years of post\-MBA experience / Relevant experience and is looking to build a career at the intersection of business, technology, and product management.
* Can combine business thinking with enough technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and technology teams.
* Is comfortable translating ambiguous business problems into structured product opportunities and clear requirements.
* Has strong influencing and stakeholder\-management skills and can create alignment without formal authority.
* Demonstrates the ability to drive adoption and change across diverse stakeholder groups.
* Is analytically strong and comfortable using data, KPIs, user feedback, and business signals to make decisions.
* Can communicate clearly with senior leaders, business users, engineers, data teams, designers, vendors, and other partners.
* Has strong ownership, bias for action, learning agility, and resilience in a fast\-moving environment.
* Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, cloud, and modern digital platforms.

**Job Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a recognized institution.
* Less than 3 years of professional experience post\-MBA.
* Prior professional experience in technology, software engineering, data, IT, digital, systems, or another technology\-focused role.
* Strong understanding of technology\-enabled business solutions and the software development lifecycle.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, influencing, structured problem\-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across business and technology teams and translate between the two.

**About Us**

**We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders can lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories, and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head \& Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral\-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.**

**Visit** **http://www.pg.com** **to know more.**

**We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals based on race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.**

***At P\&G, the hiring journey is personalized every step of the way, thereby ensuring equal opportunities for all, with a strong foundation of Ethics \& Corporate Responsibility guiding everything we do.***

***All the available job opportunities are posted either on our website \- pgcareers.com, or on our official social media pages, for the convenience of prospective candidates, and do not require them to pay any kind of fees towards their application.”***

title: Senior Product Owner - Service and Supervision (IVR)
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

  

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

  

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

**Job Overview:**


The Omni IVR Product Owner will be responsible for defining, prioritizing, and delivering enhancements that improve the customer voice experience through natural language understanding, intelligent call routing, and contact center automation. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and vendor partners to translate customer and advisor needs into actionable product requirements, optimize call flows, reduce misroutes, improve containment, and ensure IVR capabilities align with service strategy, operational readiness, and measurable business outcomes.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Partner closely with the Product Manager to translate the Omni IVR roadmap into prioritized features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint\-ready backlog items that support natural language, call routing, and service experience objectives.
* Own day\-to\-day Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, story prioritization, dependency management, sprint planning support, requirement clarification, and coordination with delivery teams to ensure roadmap commitments are executed successfully.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, operations, technology, UX, analytics, and vendor partners to gather requirements, validate call flow changes, support testing, resolve defects, and drive continuous improvement across IVR routing, containment, and caller experience.

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------


We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 7–8 years of experience working with voice systems, IVR platforms, contact center technologies, or related customer service technology solutions.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner or in a similar product delivery role, including backlog management, user story creation, acceptance criteria definition, and sprint execution support.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, demos, testing support, and production readiness activities.
* Ability to translate business needs, caller experience goals, and operational requirements into clear features, user stories, call flow changes, and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, and vendor teams.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Advanced collaboration and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across Product Management, technology, operations, analytics, UX, vendors, and business stakeholders to drive shared outcomes.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to lead requirement discussions, clarify complex needs, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse teams.
* Value\-driven product ownership mindset, with the ability to balance client experience, operational efficiency, technical feasibility, roadmap priorities, and delivery commitments while acting with integrity and helping the team win together.

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience with natural language understanding, conversational IVR, speech recognition, text\-to\-speech, intent design, call routing logic, or voice bot capabilities.
* Familiarity with contact center platforms, telephony technologies, CRM integrations, routing strategies, call flow design, or service center operations.
* Experience using data, reporting, or performance metrics such as containment, misroutes, transfer rates, call volume, average handle time, and customer experience trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Proficiency with Agile delivery tools and documentation practices, such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio, or similar tools used for backlog management, process flows, and requirement traceability.

title: Product Supply Planning Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. Our Supply Chain team is growing, and we are looking to strengthen it with a passionate and driven team member. If you are eager to be part of a dynamic, global, and fast\-growing organization—where a positive mindset, personal development, and making a meaningful impact on people's health are valued—we could be the perfect match. As Product Supply Planning Manager, you will own the end\-to\-end supply plan for our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), collaborate across departments, and play an active role in shaping the future of our company.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Create and maintain the supply plan for CMOs on a monthly basis, considering inventory and open orders (firmed and planned), to identify and communicate status to internal and external stakeholders.
* Based on the supply plan, issue Purchase Orders and forecasts to CMOs, and monitor deliveries of purchase orders against requested dates.
* Proactively manage supply constraints to minimize business impact.
* Provide accurate and complete supply planning parameters and purchasing conditions for all SKUs; act as the Expert User for key planning Master Data.
* Set and maintain all required Master Data and ensure its integrity and correctness.
* Create and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external partners.
* Oversee the successful launch of new products into the market, ensuring timely supply, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with manufacturing and distribution teams.
* Propose stock holding levels within the supply chain through a detailed understanding of key planning parameters and the E2E process (safety stock, lead times, supply reliability, demand variability, service objectives), in line with Working Capital targets.
* Perform monthly inventory reconciliations, ensure inventory accuracy, and minimize discrepancies.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* Minimum 10 years of proven experience in end\-to\-end (E2E) planning within the pharmaceutical industry, including direct interaction with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities and evolving business needs.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with excellent communication abilities.
* Proven track record of effective collaboration with both internal cross\-functional teams and external partners.
* Strong time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks efficiently.
* Quick learner with a proactive and adaptable mindset.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Familiarity with Oracle ERP systems; functional knowledge is an advantage.
* APICS/ASCM certification (CPIM or CSCP) or equivalent supply chain qualification.
* Experience supporting new product introductions/launches in a regulated (GMP) pharmaceutical environment.
* Experience working across multiple time zones with global CMO networks.


By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Content Strategist
description:
Content Strategist

**Company: IRAA Digital Marketing**  
**Location: Hyderabad**  
**Employment Type: Full\-Time**

About the Role

IRAA Digital Marketing is looking for a creative and strategic **Content Strategist** with prior **agency experience** to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing content strategies, defining brand voice, and providing creative direction across multiple client brands and industries.

This role requires someone who understands how content can build brands, engage audiences, and support business objectives. You should be comfortable working with multiple clients, managing different brand personalities, and turning ideas into effective content plans.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute comprehensive content strategies for multiple client brands.
* Create monthly and campaign\-based content calendars aligned with brand objectives.
* Establish and maintain a consistent brand voice and communication style for each client.
* Develop creative concepts and content ideas for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, websites, and other digital platforms.
* Provide creative direction for reels, videos, photoshoots, social media creatives, campaigns, and other content formats.
* Work closely with designers, video editors, photographers, social media managers, and other creative team members.
* Research industry trends, competitors, target audiences, and emerging content formats.
* Convert marketing objectives into engaging and relevant content concepts.
* Review and provide feedback on creative work to ensure brand consistency and quality.
* Plan content around product launches, campaigns, festivals, promotions, and important brand moments.
* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future strategies.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency.

Requirements

* **2\+ years of experience in content strategy, content marketing, or a similar role**, preferably within a digital marketing or creative agency.
* Strong understanding of social media platforms and current content trends.
* Excellent copywriting, communication, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to understand different industries, audiences, and brand personalities.
* Strong creative thinking and conceptualization skills.
* Experience working with multiple clients simultaneously is highly preferred.
* Ability to manage deadlines and coordinate with creative teams.
* Good understanding of social media marketing and digital branding.
* Knowledge of reels, short\-form video content, campaigns, and social media creatives is an advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - Net Revenue Management
description:
Overview:

RGM strategy Playbook \- Associate plays a pivotal role in our organization, with a primary focus on brand ladder and price pack architecture analysis, Mix Management and Promo Strategy. This role encompasses a range of responsibilities related to optimizing our product and pricing strategies to maximize brand equity, profitability, and consumer engagement.


Key responsibilities of the Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate include:

* Conducting in\-depth market research and data analysis to identify and evaluate brand positioning / price pack architecture opportunities
* Analyzing consumer behavior and preferences to gain insights into how our brand ladder / pricing strategies impact purchasing decisions
* Developing and refining brand ladder and PPA models and methodologies to streamline decision\-making / enhance operational efficiency
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure that our brand and pricing strategies align with overarching business objectives and regulatory requirements
* Utilizing data\-driven insights to enhance the overall consumer experience and perception of our brands and pricing structures
* Contributing to the long\-term brand and pricing strategy of the organization, actively participating in the creation of innovative approaches to optimize brand equity and profitability


The Brand Ladder / Price Pack Architecture (PPA) Playbook \- Associate leverages advanced analytical skills and tools to shape our brand and pricing strategies, ensuring they are aligned with our strategic goals, compliance standards, and customer satisfaction objectives


Responsibilities:
* Perform advanced analytics using Tableau/Power BI and develop predictive models, regression modeling, price elasticity analysis, and promotion optimization to extract actionable insights from data
* Collaborate on sector NRM strategic projects, such as promotions optimization, terms priorities, competitor benchmarking, and Price Pack Architecture (PPA) initiatives, to drive revenue realization
* Conduct statistical and trend analysis to identify market opportunities, highlight sector strengths, and provide recommended corrective actions to enhance performance
* Monitor existing KPI metrics, develop new relevant metrics, and identify correlations and root causes to support data\-driven decision\-making
* Design and build visualization dashboards to accelerate information\-to\-action at scale, enabling easy access to critical insights for various stakeholders
* Develop programs, methodologies, and reports for analyzing and presenting data, making data\-driven insights accessible and actionable
* Ensure the timely and accurate submission of reports and data to the Revenue Management teams in line with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA)
* Improve the utility of operational and performance data within various teams, supporting Business Intelligence (BI), reporting, analysis, and insights efforts
* Assist the GBS Commercial lead in developing an ongoing training and capability plan for COE associates, ensuring continuous growth and expertise development within the team


Qualifications:

Key Skills/Experience Required

* Broader data analysis capabilities. Previous experience in Consumer Insights, Key account Management, Trade Marketing or CPG consulting
* Experience in pricing and promotions management, demonstrating a deep understanding of pricing strategies, market dynamics, and consumer behavior
* Proven experience working in the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) sector with a strong understanding of business processes related to Revenue Management, including promotions, pricing, and sales
* Excellent visualisation skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable solutions and processes, enabling data\-driven decision\-making
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and a strong command of PowerPoint, with the ability to quickly learn various in\-house software applications for data analysis and reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI software is added advantage
* Ability to function effectively in a team environment and collaborate with individuals across the organization, as pricing and promotions strategies often require cross\-functional teamwork
* Good verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and present findings and recommendations in a clear and compelling manner


Differentiating Competencies Required

  

* Highly organized and responsive, with ability to work to SLAs and tight deadlines
* Numerate thinker, good at data analysis with strong attention to detail
* Language skills \- English fluent
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; proactively communicates using appropriate methods for situation and audience in clear, concise and professional manner
* Ability to work collaboratively and proactively with multi\-functional teams
* Be flexible, organized and able to handle competing priorities
* Ability to combine insights from various data sources

title: Senior Manager - Net Revenue Management
description:
Overview:

ICC is a growing function within PepsiCo that leverages one strategy and common approach to introduce new, technology\-driven capabilities and elevate service quality while meeting current and future business needs. PEP RGM is a key priority function where transformation, technology, strategy and capabilities enablement are aimed to be the best in class, and to be standardized and deployed globally. The vision is to develop playbook to develop analytic packs with insights across Brand Ladders, Channel PPA, In\-Market Pack Price realization, Trade Investment Strategy, Promo ROI and Mix Management. This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.

  



This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution


Responsibilities:

Functional Responsibilities

* ICC RGM analyst will be responsible for conducting data analyses across all RGM levers \- Pricing, Promotion, Assortment Mix and Trade Investment
* Lead data aggregation and harmonization that will form the backbone of RGM analytics
* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses
* Bring out Next Gen Revenue Management insights by implementing advance analytics
* Integrate insights comprehensive summaries for RGM Tower Lead and RGM leader
* Improve understanding of pricing, promotions, pack architecture and trade investments through use of data analytic tools and visualization tools
* Improve processes of analyses and data management across category business units and marketing functions
* Develop observations/insights for each analysis in the RGM playbook and synthesize insights across analyses to create a storyline of opportunities
* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market


Qualifications:
* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

title: Product Owner - Digital Lab Platform
description:
India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-248037 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Sep. 08, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems
At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives all that we do. In this vital role, you will join Amgen's Transformative Digital Capabilities (TDC) organization and help advance the next generation of digital capabilities supporting Process Development.

**What will you do?**


As a Product Owner supporting digital lab and data platform capabilities, you will work at the intersection of science, technology, data, and business process transformation. You will partner with stakeholders across Process Development, digital product teams, data and engineering teams, and end users to define, prioritize, and deliver capabilities that improve data quality, user experience, lab execution efficiency, and scientific insight generation.


This role requires an end\-to\-end product owner mindset, strong stakeholder engagement, and the ability to translate business and scientific needs into a well\-managed roadmap and backlog. This role independently manages multiple assignments, owns tactical segments of broader programs, anticipates issues, and helps shape practical solutions aligned with team objectives and business value.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Partner with business, scientific, and technology stakeholders to define and deliver an industry\-leading digital thread spanning lab execution systems and data analytics platforms.
* Drive the digital platform strategy to improve data quality, enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of lab experimentation, and unlock novel insights through data science to accelerate pipeline advancement.
* Own and manage product backlog with clear prioritization aligned to business value and TDC strategy.
* Drive product roadmap planning and execution aligned with product vision.
* Lead requirements definition, user story development, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering teams through Agile/Scrum delivery.
* Collaborate with functional leads and users to refine backlog and priorities.
* Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), business validation, and release readiness.
* Enable solution adoption through training materials and stakeholder engagement.
* Monitor product performance and user feedback for continuous improvement.
* Ensure alignment with data governance and enterprise architecture standards.
**Basic Qualifications**

* Doctorate OR
* Master's degree and 3 years of relevant experience OR
* Bachelor's degree and 5 years of relevant experience
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of structured/unstructured data (SQL/NoSQL).
* Experience with digital lab platforms such as ELN and LIMS in Pharma R\&D.
* Knowledge of cloud data platforms like Databricks or Redshift.
* Familiarity with Generative AI, digital twins, and analytics applications.
* Strong product management and Agile delivery experience.
* Ability to translate scientific needs into scalable digital solutions.
* Proficiency in Python or similar tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder collaboration skills.
